channel.title: Pabsmophobia Newsletter
channel.description: Field updates, historical write-ups, and paranormal investigations from the Pabsmophobia team.

item.title: A Seat at the Table: When Our Loved Ones Visit on Special Days
item.description: There's a unique kind of quiet on special occasions—birthdays, anniversaries, holidays—after the wrapping paper is cleared and the candles are blown out. In the midst of the celebration, many of us feel a faint, unmistakable echo, a sense that someone is missing, and yet, somehow, they are also present.

item.title: Shadows in the Stone: Investigating Historic Locations
item.description: An in-depth look at how historic architecture, residual energy, and environmental factors intersect during our late-night vigils and public ghost hunts.

item.title: Tools of the Trade: EMF, K2, and Spirit Boxes Explained
item.description: A breakdown of how we calibrate and utilize specialized investigative equipment to separate environmental anomalies from unexplained phenomena.

item.title: The Middle Ground: Skepticism Meets Belief in Parapsychology
item.description: Why adopting a balanced investigative philosophy between complete skepticism and absolute belief is crucial for modern paranormal research.

item.title: Looking Ahead: 2026 Investigations and Team Updates
item.description: A look forward at our scheduled venue broadcasts, upcoming public ghost hunts with Haunting Nights, and new digital media content releases.
